versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Gemini CLI skill with multi-model API support.

- Supports one-shot Q&A, summaries, and content generation via command line.
- Access 50+ models for chat, image, video, TTS, STT, music, search, document parsing, email, and SMS.
- Single API key unlocks models from Bedrock, OpenAI, Vertex, Replicate, ElevenLabs, Minimax, and more.
- Includes smart routing to auto-select the cheapest or highest-quality model for a given task.
- Detailed usage examples and model parameters provided in documentation.
